title: fix(lint)!: security-role-word judges what an objectExtensions entry writes onto an object, at the CLI and the object_extension publish door
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzja9cCxkep8Py2WTWJa

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBRaNSMLtEdc42LRJUS7rMHK)_

Fixes #31998

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed (an `objectExtensions` entry's field name or label, its `label`, or a `fieldPatches` relabel using the reserved word is refused by `os validate` / `os build` / `os verify` and by the `object_extension` publish door, where all passed; measured below)
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -i "security-role-word\|reserved word" -- skills content/docs` at `dcc2177d`: 0 hits in `skills/`; 5 in `content/docs/` (`deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` x2, `permissions/authorization.mdx` x1, `releases/v13.mdx` x2). `validating-metadata.mdx`'s vocabulary-freeze cell and type legend became false (the rule now declares a sixth write type) and gain `object_extension` plus one paragraph; the other three stay true.
Prior rulings read: security-role-word,objectextensions,validatesecurityroleword → 2 hits; ADR-0029 D3, ADR-0146 D10; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：保留词 role 的检查（`security-role-word`）现在也检查对象扩展（`objectExtensions`）写到对象上的内容：扩展新增字段的名字和标签、扩展的 `label`、`fieldPatches` 里的字段改标签；`os validate` / `build` / `verify` 和 Studio 发布 `object_extension` 的入口都会拒绝，消息与对象自身声明时一字不差，位置指向作者写的扩展条目。
- 为什么改：QA 场景里作者在对象字段上被拒后，把同一个 `role` 字段挪进对象扩展，结果 validate、build、verify 全过，应用带着 `role` 字段启动；同一个词一个入口拒、另一个入口放，正是 ADR-0090 D3 规则文档禁止的形状。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧拒绝面；对象自身的判断不变（对照用例钉住）。给 `sys_*` 对象加字段的扩展也会被判（系统对象豁免只覆盖平台自己的声明）。首方包里的三个扩展（showcase、plugin-auth、downstream-contract）都不含该词。已存的扩展照常读取，只有下次发布会被拒。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` 的 `validateSecurityRoleWord` 末段扩展走查（约 1735-1775 行）；`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts` 新增的 `object_extension` 行；`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` 该规则的 `runtimeTypes`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-security-posture.test.ts -t 31998`，预期 8 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`validate-security-posture.ts` `validateSecurityRoleWord`** walks every `objectExtensions` entry through the shared fold `objectExtensionsByTarget` and judges, with the owner door's messages and `error` severity: each field the entry adds (name, then label), the entry's own `label` (kind `object`), and each `fieldPatches.FIELD.label` (kind `field`). A finding's `path` is the entry the author wrote (`objectExtensions[i].fields.F.name`, `….fields.F.label`, `objectExtensions[i].label`, `objectExtensions[i].fieldPatches.F.label`; in an artifact `packages[j].manifest.objectExtensions[i]…`); its `where` is the owner door's (`field "TARGET.F"`, `object "TARGET"`). The label half of `flagRole` is factored into `flagRoleLabel` for the two labels that have no identifier beside them; `flagRole`'s output is byte-identical.
- **No system-object exemption on the extension walk** (seat decision): `isSystemObject` covers the platform's own declarations (better-auth `sys_member.role`), not a field an app's extension adds to a `sys_*` object.
- **`object-graph.ts` `VisibleObjectExtension`** carries the entry's `label` and its `fieldPatches` record (record-valued patches only), for this one reader. Which entries survive is unchanged. The receiver-key meta-test's `ext` row gains both keys (both declared by `ObjectExtensionSchema`) and a `displayPatch` row (`label`, declared by the patch schema).
- **Runtime publish gate.** `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY` gains `object_extension: 'objectExtensions'` and the rule's registry entry declares `object_extension` in `runtimeTypes` (claim amendment 2). The rule crosses whole, on its own entry, as commit a227afa41 crossed `position` / `app`. Not a context row: the freeze resolves nothing into siblings, and an extension carries no `name`, so the written item is `objectExtensions[0]` and is never name-keyed.
- **Tests.** `validate-security-posture.test.ts`: one describe, 8 cases (name, label, `packages[]` body, extension label + `fieldPatches` label with option labels silent, clean showcase shape, `sys_*` target with the owner `sys_member.role` control, owner and extension side by side, a replaced same-package entry). `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts`: the whole-means-whole derivation counts the fold call as the `objectExtensions` key it reads (six keys now), the `runtimeTypes` literal gains `object_extension`, and one door case: refusal at the real gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`), the two labels, a lit control with `rulesRun` exactly `['validateSecurityRoleWord']`, and the snapshot shape.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`: the vocabulary-freeze cell gains `ᵒˣ`, the legend names it `object_extension`, one paragraph says what an extension is judged on.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31998-role-word-object-extensions.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, BREAKING banner, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (PR #30533 precedent).

### Before / after against `main`

`validateSecurityRoleWord` at `c9246279` (main) and at this head, one stack per row (throwaway probe importing main's file beside this one, deleted). Cells are the finding paths.

| Shape | main | this head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| extension field named `role` | silent | `objectExtensions[0].fields.role.name` |
| extension field labelled `Support Role` | silent | `objectExtensions[0].fields.duty.label` |
| same field in a `packages[]` body | silent | `packages[0].manifest.objectExtensions[0].fields.role.name` |
| extension `label: 'Agent Roles'` | silent | `objectExtensions[0].label` |
| `fieldPatches: { tier: { label: 'Role Tier' } }` | silent | `objectExtensions[0].fieldPatches.tier.label` |
| extension field `support_role` on `sys_user` | silent | `objectExtensions[0].fields.support_role.name` |
| `fieldPatches` option label `Role A` | silent | silent |
| clean extension | silent | silent |
| owner field `role` (control) | `objects[0].fields.role.name` | `objects[0].fields.role.name` |
| owner `sys_member.role` (control) | silent | silent |

### Runtime gate reading

The door can receive an extension: `object_extension` is `allowRuntimeCreate: true` (`DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`), the save door calls `runAuthoringGate` for every type (`protocol-save.ts`), and `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` filters on nothing but `runtimeTypes`. At main no rule declared `object_extension` and `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY` had no row, so the gate ran zero rules on it. Measured with a throwaway probe on the `packages/runtime` `meta-object-extension-item` rig (writable `.custom` pair, `saveMetaItem` draft then `publishMetaItem`; deleted):

| Publish of `{ extend: 'crm_account', fields: { role__c: … } }` | main's lint | this head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| result | published, row `active` | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, `security-role-word` at `objectExtensions[0].fields.role__c.name`, row stays `draft` |
| clean control `region__c` | published | published |

### Ablation

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the walk's head `for (const [target, entries] of objectExtensionsByTarget(stack)) {` with the same loop over `[...objectExtensionsByTarget(stack)].filter(() => false)` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 3314a6ee → 2e85b40f), ran both test files: **8 failed / 224** (the 7 refusal cases of the CLI describe and the door case; the clean-extension case stays green). Restored: blob == HEAD 3314a6ee, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `./validate-security-posture.js` from `src`, so no dist rebuild was needed for this leg.

## Why

ADR-0090 D3 freezes the word on security-relevant identifiers and labels, and the rule's own docblock forbids one door refusing a name another admits. The QA service-desk scenario (#31433) hit the refusal on an object field and declared the same field through `objectExtensions` instead; `validate`, `build` and `verify` passed and the app booted with `NS_agent.role`, because the rule never read extensions. The `object_extension` publish door ran no lint rule at all, so the same field also published from Studio.

## Acceptance notes

- **`object-graph.ts` is outside the claim's file surface.** Ruling 2 of claim amendment 2 (judge the extension's `label` and `fieldPatches` labels) needs the fold to carry them; the edit adds two read-only keys to `VisibleObjectExtension` and changes nothing about which entries survive. Named here for the seat.
- **Not judged, by design:** `pluralLabel`, option labels and `description` (the owner door judges none of them on an object); the `extend` value itself (it names the target, whose own door judges its name); an entry a later entry of the same package replaces for the same target (its fields are never served).
- **First-party census.** Every `objectExtensions` declaration under `packages/**` and `examples/**` source: `examples/app-showcase` (`showcase_account`), `plugin-auth` (`sys_sso_provider.oidc_client_secret`), `qa/downstream-contract` (`dc_account.note`). None uses the word, so nothing is refused and no fork arose. Dogfood battery below.
- **Other rules that read declared objects only** (the #30533 census: validate-form-layout, notify-email-field-recipients, public-form-file-fields, flow-template-paths, page-visualization-bindings, searchable-fields, lint-autonumber-formats, validate-sortable-fields) are out of scope and untouched.
- **The runtime gate runs only this rule on `object_extension`.** No other lint rule declares the type, so an extension's validations, formulas and field references are judged at that door by the metadata-protocol extension judges only. Not in scope; noted.

## Tests

Every code path at this head (`dcc2177d`) is byte-identical to `a03bbcad`, where these ran (the three later commits touch only the changeset and `validating-metadata.mdx`). Each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, after a build of the closure.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates: 96 run on dcc2177d, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 96 families against merge base `c9246279`; each was run on `dcc2177d` (after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`) and recorded as `CMD :: exit N`. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.

Fixed on the way: `check:role-word` reddened on the first pass because the new docs paragraph spelled a finding path with the reserved word as its field name; it now reads `objectExtensions[0].fields.FIELD.name`. `check-adr-0087-registration` reddened on a rewrite arrow in the author section (read as a FROM-TO prescription); the section now states the move without one.

Declaration gates with this body as the event (`--event`): `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 and `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0. Control: the same body with `Clause-②: no` (no arm) makes `check-changeset-no-major` exit 1 ("metadata-protocol narrowed contradicts clause-② no"), which is why the line carries `(narrowing)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock at `7689ce08` (code identical to `dcc2177d`; the last commit edits only the changeset's declaration line), after a full build and `rm -rf packages/runtime/.objectstack`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 445 passed, 3 skipped (448); Tests 3689 passed, 42 skipped (3731). No failure.

</details>
